Name: Common Sensor Ephemeris Data DES
Description: The Common Sensor Ephemeris data (CSEPHB) DES (Table M.6-6) provides chronologically-ordered platform ephemeris information needed to run the rigorous sensor model that performs geolocation and mensuration. There are two versions of the CSEPHB DES. In both versions, the ECI_ECF_EPHEM field designates whether ephemeris vectors are in ECI (value = 0) or ECF (value = 1) coordinates. In version 1, if ECI is designated, then no ECI-to-ECF transformation information is provided, the DT_EPHEM field immediately follows the ECI_ECF_EPHEM field, and MSP cannot mensurate the dataset. In version 2, however, if the ECI_ECF_EPHEM field value = 0 (i.e., ECI vectors), then a set of 32 required ECI-to-ECF transformation parameters immediately follows the ECI_ECF_EPHEM field. Reference [1] provides the equations as a function of these parameters. Although both DES versions are valid, version 2 is strongly recommended when ECI_ECF_EPHEM = 0 (ECI). If ECI_ECF_EPHEM = 1 (ECF), then the logic is the same for both DES versions 1 and 2 because ECI-to-ECF transformation parameters are not needed and thus not present in the DES. Note that the MSP GLAS/GFM model disables error propagation by setting the number of adjustable parameters to zero if QUAL_FLAG_EPH = 0 (suspect data). A value of ECI_ECF_EPHEM = 0 (ECI) in CSEPHB DES version 1 is not supported by all MSP versions that claim GLAS/GFM conformance. Data providers who use this option, and whose consumers rely on MSP for georeferencing and mensuration functions, must ensure that those consumers have access to a suitable version of MSP within their toolset.

DE.Name: File Part Type
DE.Description: This field shall contain the characters DE.

DESID.Name: Unique DES Type Indentifier
DESID.Description: This field shall contain a valid identifier properly registered with the GWG NTB.

DESVER.Name: Version of the Data Definition
DESVER.Description: This field shall contain the alphanumeric version number of the use of the tag. The version number is assigned as part of the registration process.

DESCLAS.Name: Data Extension File Security Classification
DESCLAS.Description: This field shall contain a valid value representing the classification level of the DES. Valid values are T for Top Secret, S for Secret, C for Confidential, R for Restricted, or U for Unclassified.

DESSHL.Name: DES User-Defined Subheader Length
DESSHL.Description: This field contains the number of bytes in the user-defined subheader.

UUID.Name: Assigned UUID for the DES
UUID.Description: This UUID refers to the entire DES, i.e., both the subheader and the data portions of the DES.

NUMAIS.Name: Number of Associated Image Segments
NUMAIS.Description: This field provides the number of image segments associated with this DES. If NUMAIS = ALL, the DES is associated with all image segments in the NITF dataset, and field AISDLVLn is omitted. Otherwise, NUMAIS is between 1 and 998 (999 is covered by ALL) and is no more than the number of image segments in the dataset.

AISDLVL<NUMAIS>.Name: nth Associated Image Segment Display Level
AISDLVL<NUMAIS>.Description: This field provides the Image Display Level (IDLVL) of each image segment associated with this DES. AISDLVLn shall correspond to IDLVL values of image segments in the same dataset. If NUMAIS = ALL, this field is omitted.

NUM_ASSOC_ELEM.Name: Number of Associated Elements
NUM_ASSOC_ELEM.Description: This field contains the number of elements associated with this DES. For Level 1 and 2 conformance, this list shall include the IMAGE_UUID from the CSEXRB TRE for all images associated with this DES, as well as the UUIDs of any other elements that are authoritatively associated with this DES.

ASSOC_ELEM_UUID<NUM_ASSOC_ELEM>.Name: UUID of the nth Associated Element
ASSOC_ELEM_UUID<NUM_ASSOC_ELEM>.Description: This field contains the UUID of the nth element associated with the DES. The type of associated element is unrestricted.

RESERVEDSUBH_LEN.Name: Length of Reserved Subheader Field
RESERVEDSUBH_LEN.Description: This field contains the length of the reserved subheader field. This field value shall be 0000.

RESERVEDSUBH.Name: Reserved Subheader Field
RESERVEDSUBH.Description: This field shall be reserved for future use.

QUAL_FLAG_EPH.Name: Ephemeris Data Quality Flag
QUAL_FLAG_EPH.Description: This field indicates the quality of the provided ephemeris data.

INTERP_TYPE_EPH.Name: Interpolation Type
INTERP_TYPE_EPH.Description: This field identifies the type of interpolation recommended for the end user.

INTERP_ORDER_EPH.Name: Order of Interpolation Polynomial
INTERP_ORDER_EPH.Description: This field indicates the order of the interpolation plynomials recommended for the end user.

EPHEM_FLAG.Name: Ephemeris Source Type
EPHEM_FLAG.Description: This field identifies the source of orbit determination ephemeris data. Refined ephemeris data (ATT_TYPE = 2) indicates smoothed ephemeris data resulting from data processing.

ECI_ECF_EPHEM.Name: Coordinate Reference Fram Flag
ECI_ECF_EPHEM.Description: This field identifies whether ephemeris data are with respect to Earth-Centered Fixed (ECF) or Earth-Centered Inertial (ECI) reference frames.

TA_POLE.Name: Polar Wander Parameter Time
TA_POLE.Description: This field provides the Julian date associated with the polar wander parameters.

A_POLE.Name: Polar Wander Parameter in Arc-Seconds
A_POLE.Description: This field provides the polar wander parameter A in arc-seconds.

B_POLE.Name: Polar Wander Parameter in Arc-Seconds
B_POLE.Description: This field provides the polar wander parameter B in arc-seconds/day.

CJ1_POLE.Name: Polar Wander Parameter CJ1
CJ1_POLE.Description: This field provides the polar wander parameter CJ1 in arc-seconds.

CJ2_POLE.Name: Polar Wander Parameter CJ2
CJ2_POLE.Description: This field provides the polar wander parameter CJ2 in arc-seconds.

DJ1_POLE.Name: Polar Wander Parameter DJ1
DJ1_POLE.Description: This field provides the polar wander parameter DJ1 in arc-seconds.

DJ2_POLE.Name: Polar Wander Parameter DJ2
DJ2_POLE.Description: This field provides the polar wander parameter DJ2 in arc-seconds.

PJ1_POLE.Name: Polar Wander Period PJ1
PJ1_POLE.Description: This field provides the period PJ1 (Julian days) associated with the polar wander parameters.

PJ2_POLE.Name: Polar Wander Period PJ2
PJ2_POLE.Description: This field provides the period PJ2 (Julian days) associated with the polar wander parameters.

E_POLE.Name: Polar Wander Parameter E
E_POLE.Description: This field provides the polar wander parameter E in arc-seconds.

F_POLE.Name: Polar Wander Parameter F
F_POLE.Description: This field provides the polar wander parameter F in arc-seconds/day.

GK1_POLE.Name: Polar Wander Parameter GK1
GK1_POLE.Description: This field provides the polar wander parameter GK1 in arc-seconds.

GK2_POLE.Name: Polar Wander Parameter GK2
GK2_POLE.Description: This field provides the polar wander parameter GK2 in arc-seconds.

HK1_POLE.Name: Polar Wander Parameter HK1
HK1_POLE.Description: This field provides the polar wander parameter HK1 in arc-seconds.

HK2_POLE.Name: Polar Wander Parameter HK2
HK2_POLE.Description: This field provides the polar wander parameter HK2 in arc-seconds.

PK1_POLE.Name: Polar Wander Parameter PK1
PK1_POLE.Description: This field provides the period PK1 (Julian days) associated with the polar wander parameters.

PK2_POLE.Name: Polar Wander Parameter PK2
PK2_POLE.Description: This field provides the period PK2 (Julian days) associated with the polar wander parameters.

TB_UT.Name: Time Associated with UT Parameters
TB_UT.Description: This field provides the time (Julian date) associated with the universal time (UT) parameters.

I_UT.Name: UT Parameter I in Seconds
I_UT.Description: This field provides the UT parameter I in seconds.

J_UT.Name: UT Parameter J in Seconds/Day
J_UT.Description: This field provides the UT parameter J in seconds/day.

KN_1.Name: UT Parameter KN1 in Seconds
KN_1.Description: This field provides the UT parameter KN1 in seconds.

KN_2.Name: UT Parameter KN2 in Seconds
KN_2.Description: This field provides the UT parameter KN2 in seconds.

KN_3.Name: UT Parameter KN3 in Seconds
KN_3.Description: This field provides the UT parameter KN3 in seconds.

KN_4.Name: UT Parameter KN4 in Seconds
KN_4.Description: This field provides the UT parameter KN4 in seconds.

LN_1.Name: UT Parameter LN1 in Seconds
LN_1.Description: This field provides the UT parameter LN1 in seconds.

LN_2.Name: UT Parameter LN2 in Seconds
LN_2.Description: This field provides the UT parameter LN2 in seconds.

LN_3.Name: UT Parameter LN3 in Seconds
LN_3.Description: This field provides the UT parameter LN3 in seconds.

LN_4.Name: UT Parameter LN4 in Seconds
LN_4.Description: This field provides the UT parameter LN4 in seconds.

PN_1.Name: Period PN1 in Julian Days
PN_1.Description: This field provides the period PN1 in (Julian days) associated with the UT parameters.

PN_2.Name: Period PN2 in Julian Days
PN_2.Description: This field provides the period PN2 in (Julian days) associated with the UT parameters.

PN_3.Name: Period PN3 in Julian Days
PN_3.Description: This field provides the period PN3 in (Julian days) associated with the UT parameters.

PN_4.Name: Period PN4 in Julian Days
PN_4.Description: This field provides the period PN4 in (Julian days) associated with the UT parameters.

DT_EPHEM.Name: Time Between Ephemeris Vectors
DT_EPHEM.Description: This field contains the time interval between chronologically ordered consecutive ephemeris vectors in seconds.

DATE_EPHEM.Name: Date of the First Ephemeris Vector
DATE_EPHEM.Description: This field contains the date of the first ephemeris vector formatted as CCYYMMDD.

T0_EPHEM.Name: UTC Time Stamp of First Ephemeris Vector
T0_EPHEM.Description: This field shall contain the time stamp of the first ephemeris formatted as hhmmss.nnnnnnnnn.

NUM_EPHEM.Name: Number of Ephemeris Vectors
NUM_EPHEM.Description: This field shall contain the number of ephemeris vectors.

EPHEM_X<NUM_EPHEM>.Name: X Coordinate of the nth Ephemeris Vector
EPHEM_X<NUM_EPHEM>.Description: This field contains the X coordinate in meters, in either the ECI or ECF reference frame, depending upon the value of ECI_ECF_EPHEM, for the nth ephemeris vector. Ephemeris vectors are listed in chronological order.

EPHEM_Y<NUM_EPHEM>.Name: Y Coordinate of the nth Ephemeris Vector
EPHEM_Y<NUM_EPHEM>.Description: This field contains the Y coordinate in meters, in either the ECI or ECF reference frame, depending upon the value of ECI_ECF_EPHEM, for the nth ephemeris vector. Ephemeris vectors are listed in chronological order.

EPHEM_Z<NUM_EPHEM>.Name: Z Coordinate of the nth Ephemeris Vector
EPHEM_Z<NUM_EPHEM>.Description: This field contains the Z coordinate in meters, in either the ECI or ECF reference frame, depending upon the value of ECI_ECF_EPHEM, for the nth ephemeris vector. Ephemeris vectors are listed in chronological order.

RESERVED.Name: Reserved Field
RESERVED.Description: This field value shall be reserved for future use.
